notes.title: New launcher and great deals!
notes.content:
Now, you can access to AR-K: The Great Escape with the first AR-K launcher.

And remember: Humble Bundle Kickstarter Edition is live! You can pay what you want for AR-K:

[img]https://humblebundle-a.akamaihd.net/misc/files/hashed/65a80b8107911ff3a71c92c6903230ca82bf0229.png[/img]

Probably, an EPIC combo to purchase AR-K+AR-K: The Great Escape at a great price!

Follow this steps:

1. Pay what you want for the Bundle:
https://www.humblebundle.com/weekly

2. Activate AR-K with the steam key

3. Purchase AR-K: The Great Escape with the 73% discount! (only this week if you own the first game)

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! LINUX VERSION IS HERE!
notes.content:
Hi! 

Our first major update is here! We've put a ton of work into improving our game, and we fixed all the known bugs.

Thanks to our costumers for helping us, and sorry for the inconvenience up to this moment!

Remember that you can add me as a friend (http://steamcommunity.com/id/sprietoGato/) to your Steam account if you have any bug, I'll give you a personal attention to solve all the problems you may have found :)


And now we have a Linux version, enjoy it! :D
